author: National Geographic
description:
Never forget. On the twenty-fifth anniversary of 9/11, join National Geographic in remembering the lives that were lost on September 11, 2001 in the terror attacks in New York City, Washington D.C., and Pennsylvania. In this MEGA episode, survivors share their stories, reflecting on the horrors of that day while coming together for a brighter future. 

Featuring three, full episodes: 

9/11: Reunited - 8:00 AM - 9:07 AM - 00:00 
Three men who were trapped in an elevator in the north tower on 9/11 reunite to thank one of the building’s window cleaners, whose last-minute entry into the elevator helped them all survive. A woman, who was badly injured by debris, reconnects with the stranger who stopped to save her life for the first time since 9/11.

9/11: Where Were You? Never Forget - 43:25
